text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Vasovagal syncope secondary to micturition (micturition syncope). Although you requested a diagnosis for a urinary tract infection, the clinical presentation of rapid loss of consciousness immediately after urination, with a normal ECG and no systemic infection signs, is classic for micturition syncope. I recommend staying hydrated and avoiding sudden standing after voiding.
